# Wikimedia Commons asset

This directory vendors one upstream SVG used by the calculator badge renderer.

| Local file | Wikimedia Commons source | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `HP_logo_2008.svg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:HP_logo_2008.svg | HP circular logo used from 2008 to 2014 |

The source file is nominally 1000 × 1000. Wikimedia Commons marks it as `PD-textlogo` and separately as trademarked.

All calculator models use this single geometry source. Model-specific descriptors only choose the rendered fill color; no second black-logo asset is maintained.

The file depicts an HP trademark. Its copyright status does not grant a trademark license, and it is not covered by the repository's Apache-2.0 grant to the extent repository contributors do not own rights in it.
